summary.headline: Turin Codices: Horary Topics
summary.text: Catalogue entries for Turin codices covering horary astrology: ascendant sextiles, pivots after conjunctions and full moons, wind prognostication, outcomes, stolen goods and thieves, interrogations, intercourse, separation, digging wells, and iatromathematical material attributed to Hermes, Petosiris, and Protagoras.
